chunks: Ja'far ibn al-Husayn narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Barqi from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Hisham ibn Salim from Abu Ubayda al-Hadha' from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him). He said:

Captives were brought to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), and he ordered that they be killed, except for one man among them. The man said: 'May my father and mother be your sacrifice, O Muhammad! How did you release me from among them?' He said: 'Gabriel informed me from Allah, Mighty and Glorious, that you have five qualities that Allah and His Messenger love: intense jealousy over your women, generosity, good character, a truthful tongue, and courage.' When the man heard this, he embraced Islam and beautified his Islam, and he fought intensely alongside the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) until he was martyred.

key_terms.خَمْسَ خِصَالٍ: Five qualities: the five virtues beloved by Allah and His Messenger that saved the captive

ai.seo_question: What five qualities saved a captive from execution according to Imam al-Sadiq in al-Amali?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq relates how the Prophet spared a captive from execution because Gabriel informed him the man possessed five beloved qualities: protective jealousy, generosity, good character, truthfulness, and courage. The man subsequently embraced Islam and fought as a martyr, illustrating how innate virtues can lead to faith.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ja`far b. al-Husayn narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Ja`far narrated to us from Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah al-Barqi from al-Hasan b. Mahbub from Hisham b. Salim from Abi `Ubayda al-Hadha’ from Abi `Abdillah (as). He said:

Captives were brought to the Prophet (s), and he ordered that they be killed, except for one man among them. So, the man said: May my mother and my father be your sacrifice, Muhammad. Why did you exempt me from them? So, he said: Gabriel informed me from Allah that you have five characteristics that Allah and His Messenger love: (1) jealousy over your women, (2) generosity, (3) beautiful character, (4) a truthful tongue, and (5) courage. When the man heard this, he converted to Islam and beautified his Islam. He fought intensely alongside the Messenger of Allah (s) until he was martyred.
